context_files_read.purpose: Controlling repository safety and evidence policy.
key_findings: Default development phases are capped at 100 nodes.
Fake-only gates must never be presented as real Valkey evidence.
Harness controls must not be weakened.

context_files_read.purpose: Automatic phase-loop and P14 boundary policy.
key_findings: Automatic loop completes through P13 only.
P14 requires explicit opt-in and VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN.
Machine-readable artifacts are the source of truth.
Current report is a 6-node small-real smoke with duration under 4 seconds.
It includes bounded profile metadata and some summaries.
It does not provide L09 multi-stage windows.

context_files_read.purpose: Coverage layer and P14 classification evidence.
key_findings: Current stability coverage exists only in small-real.

findings.description: L09 can falsely pass by reusing P11 small-real smoke evidence as multi-stage soak evidence.
evidence: P11 has no baseline, steady, fault, recovery, or post-recovery window records.

findings.description: 30/50/100 bounded soak profiles are resource and time expensive; failures must be BLOCKED/FAIL, not skipped PASS.
evidence: L09 requires 30/50/100 bounded soak gates or explicitly gated resource-aware profiles.

findings.description: P14 or 1000-node artifacts must not be executed or counted as stability/soak evidence.
evidence: CODEX_START_HERE.md says P14 is not automatic.

findings.description: Report-layer backflow remains a risk if HTML, SVG, CSV, or markdown trend views are parsed as source metrics.
evidence: Charts, HTML, and markdown reports are only views over versioned artifacts.

proposed_harness.name: multi_stage_soak_artifact_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: A new L09 artifact schema requires profile metadata, bounded/resource-aware flags, all five stage windows, JSONL references, source hashes, node_count, evidence_layer, missing semantics, and provenance fields.

proposed_harness.name: bounded_large_soak_profile_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: 30/50/100 soak profiles must be real bounded profiles with preflight PASS, exact node count, cleanup PASS, and bounded=true, or BLOCKED/SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with explicit resource reason; they must never be counted as long_run.

proposed_harness.name: p14_stability_boundary_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: CI fails if L09 commands, artifacts, coverage, or reports contain P14 execution or real_valkey_coverage=true for 1000-dry-run stability.

implementation_plan.step: Define the L09 artifact contract before changing runtime behavior.
implementation_plan.rationale: The current stability_report schema cannot enforce L09 stage windows, bounded flags, provenance, or missing semantics.

implementation_plan.step: Add an artifact auditor for L09 source bundles.
implementation_plan.rationale: The audit should verify JSONL samples, bounded profile semantics, exact node counts, cleanup, missing metrics, fake/real separation, and P14 exclusion.

implementation_plan.step: Integrate L09 outputs into coverage, metric catalog, provenance, and reports as views over source artifacts.
implementation_plan.rationale: Trend and window reports must not become source-of-truth and must keep dry-run, fake, and real layers separate.

acceptance_criteria: L09 has a schema-valid multi-stage soak artifact that includes baseline, steady, fault, recovery, and post-recovery windows.
Every L09 soak profile emits non-empty JSONL time series with stage/window labels, source identity, timestamps, and metric statuses.
Small real L09 soak evidence is wrapper-produced with real_valkey=true, Valkey 9.1.x, data_path_result=PASS, cluster_state_observed=ok, and cleanup PASS.
30/50/100 L09 profiles are bounded real/resource-aware profiles with exact node counts and cleanup PASS, or explicit resource-aware SKIPPED_WITH_REASON profiles.
P14 and 1000-dry-run stability entries remain dry_run_only=true and real_valkey_coverage=false.
risks: Resource risk: repeated 30/50/100 bounded soak with fault and recovery windows can exceed local Docker CPU, memory, port, or time budget.
Fake-evidence risk: deterministic fake soak timeline tests can be accidentally counted as real Valkey coverage.
Bounded-soak risk: short profile windows may be reported as long-run stability.
Cleanup risk: stale P11/L07/L08 cleanup reports may be reused instead of per-profile L09 cleanup proof.
Harness-weakening risk: permissive schemas, optional required fields, lowered node counts, deleted tests, or manual PASS gate results could hide incomplete L09 work.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not edit historical P11, L07, L08, P12, P13, or gate artifacts to fabricate L09 soak evidence.
Do not count fake tests, generated static files, or report views as real Valkey evidence.
Do not run P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN, scale_1000 configs, or set VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN in L09.
Do not claim long-run, sustained, leak-free, or production-stable results from bounded short windows.
Do not convert resource failure, timeout, port collision, Docker unavailable, partial artifact, or cleanup residue into skipped PASS.
Do not weaken scripts, schemas, tests, workflows, codex controls, templates, gate locks, or required artifact checks.
commands_to_run: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/private/tmp/valkey-scale-lab-pycache python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/stability tests/coverage tests/provenance tests/report tests/ci
git diff -- tests scripts schemas .github codex artifacts/gates artifacts/phases
notes: No unresolved high-severity blocker is present for design work if L09 adds strict artifact-first harness before implementation and preserves the P14 boundary.
